# posts.create — POST /posts

Create a post (any authenticated user; authorId = current user)

## Call
```ts
const res = await user.posts.create({ body: { title: "string", content: "string" } })
res.assert(200)
```

## Input
```ts

  "title": string
  "content": string
} }
```
